candidate_retrieval.decision_reason: Existing display policy retained; recalls are from the new held-out source groups.

risk_score.meaning: Similarity/risk score, not plagiarism probability or legal finding.
risk_score.hold_action: Escrow/review hold; never automatic upload rejection by Layer 2 alone.
risk_score.warn_action: Allow registration and display risk score/candidate references.
risk_score.automatic_upload_block: Layer 1 exact fingerprint duplicate match only.

limitations: Synthetic edits do not establish real plagiarism detection accuracy.
Normal controls are fingerprint-unique candidates, not expert-certified negative labels.
Independent cover pilot uses a separate 20-work corpus; do not combine it with synthetic metrics.
Local screen/storage integration has been implemented; team frontend and database configuration still need verification.
